judge_criteria.readability: Watch actual burned subtitle preview while hearing source: speakers, overlapping layout, corrections and reading are clear. Compare rendered content to submitted subtitle events.

judge_gates.critical_content: Use private critical_units and speaker/word references plus actual audiovisual input. No reversal or omission of negation, numerical constraints, repeated repairs or speaker identity. Do not mark official annotation disputes as candidate failure.
judge_gates.actual_preview: Output really displays submitted subtitles, not missing/wrong text or labels.
judge_gates.source_audio: Original dialogue and other speakers preserved, no muting/cuts.

task_summary: 真实四人会议困难字幕对轴：三段重排、随机角色身份、无序逐字稿；保留重叠、修正、否定与数字并交付等价双格式和烧录预览。
repeat_contract: Distinct repeated identical utterances require separate ASS events and explicit SRT cues at the same boundary. Cross-speaker technical continuation slices are deduplicated using ASS repetition boundaries. SRT numeric IDs may be nonconsecutive but must be unique.
